Watch: Six years of Earthshot Prize: Achievements and challenges
results.content: Earthshot Prize CEO Jason Knauf discusses the initiative’s achievements, its Indian finalists and how it is helping scale climate solutions and create jobs. With Mumbai hosting the sixth edition of the Earthshot Prize for the first time in India, Knauf speaks to The Hindu’s Vinaya Deshpande Pandit about India’s role in the global climate conversation and the initiative’s ambitions.

results.title: Watch: Pakistan minister to visit India after 3 years amid strained ties
results.content: Pakistan’s Climate Minister Musadik Masood Malik will visit New Delhi from November 20 to 22 to attend the SCO Civilizational Dialogue. This will be the first visit by a Pakistani Minister to India in over three years. The visit comes amid strained bilateral ties following the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack and Operation Sindoor.

Watch: India backs UNGA resolution supporting Palestinian rights over natural resources
results.content: On November 11, the 193-member United Nations General Assembly overwhelmingly passed a landmark draft resolution proposed by Uruguay regarding natural resources in occupied territories. India joined 150 member states in voting for the measure, while seven nations opposed it and eleven abstained. The resolution reaffirms the permanent rights of the Palestinian people and the population of the Syrian Golan over their land, water, and energy resources. It demands that Israel immediately cease resource exploitation, halt the construction of illegal settlements and walls, and stop destroying vital infrastructure like water pipelines and electricity networks. Furthermore, it urges support for reconstruction efforts in Gaza.
